displayIdentity.body: Promise precedes law and confinement. Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it. But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
